paite: TOUPA Angel khat Gilgal a pan Bokim ah ahohtou hi. Ama'n, "Aigupta gam a pan ka hon pawtsak a, 'na pipute uh kiang a kichiam a ka na chiamsa gam ah ka hon pilut a, noute toh ka thukhun ka bohse kei hial ding.
heading: Bokim Ah TOUPA Angel
english: Yahweh’s angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim. He said, “I brought you out of Egypt, and have brought you to the land which I swore to give your fathers. I said, ‘I will never break my covenant with you.

paite: Hiai gam a tengte toh thu khung kei unla; amaitamte uh hihchipsak un' ka chi hi. Himahleh ka thupiak na zui kei ua, bangziak in ahia hiai na hih uh?
english: You shall make no covenant with the inhabitants of this land. You shall break down their altars.’ But you have not listened to my voice. Why have you done this?

paite: Huaiziak in amaute ka hon delhkhiaksak nawn kei dia, na pang uah lingte ahi zawta ding ua, apathiante uh nou a ding in thang ahi ding uh," ka chi ahi.
english: Therefore I also said, ‘I will not drive them out from before you; but they shall be in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.’”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA angel in Israel suan tengteng kiang a hiai thu agenleh mipite aw suah hial in akap uhi.
english: When Yahweh’s angel spoke these words to all the children of Israel, the people lifted up their voice and wept.

paite: Huai mun min Bokim asa ua; huai ah TOUPA kiang ah kithoihnate alan uhi.
english: They called the name of that place Bochim, and they sacrificed there to Yahweh.

paite: Joshua in mipite akikhenzaksak nung in Israel suante michih amau tantuam gam chiat luah ding in apaita uhi.
heading: Joshua Sihna
english: Now when Joshua had sent the people away, the children of Israel each went to his inheritance to possess the land.

paite: Joshua damsung leh upate Joshua kheng a dam teng, TOUPA'N Israelte a dia thil thupi ahih tengteng mu mite damsung in mipite'n TOUPA nna asem uhi.
english: The people served Yahweh all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who had seen all the great work of Yahweh that he had worked for Israel.

paite: Nun tapa Joshua, TOUPA sikha kum za-le-sawmkhat a upa ahih in asita hi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Yahweh, died, being one hundred ten years old.

paite: Gaash tang mallam pang Ephraim tanggam a amah tantuam gamgi sung Timnath Heres ah avui uhi.
english: They buried him in the border of his inheritance in Timnath Heres, in the hill country of Ephraim, on the north of the mountain of Gaash.

paite: Huai khang a mi teng leng apipute uh kiang ah apaikhawmta uhi. Amaute nung in TOUPA leh Israelte a dia athilhihte thei lou suan dang ahong omta hi.
english: After all that generation were gathered to their fathers, another generation arose after them who didn’t know Yahweh, nor the work which he had done for Israel.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, Baal nna asem uhi.
heading: Israel In TOUPA Biak Atawpsan
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and served the Baals.

paite: TOUPA, apipute uh Pathian, Aigupta gam a pan pikhepa alehngatsan ua, pathian dangte, akim ua tengte pathiante azui ua, abia ua, TOUPA ahehsakta uhi.
english: They abandoned Yahweh, the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the peoples who were around them, and bowed themselves down to them; and they provoked Yahweh to anger.

paite: TOUPA alehngatsan ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
english: They abandoned Yahweh, and served Baal and the Ashtaroth.

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, amau dou mite khut ah apia a, amelma uh, akim ua tengte kiang ah akhawng a, amelmate uh azouta kei uhi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he delivered them into the hands of raiders who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, so that they could no longer stand before their enemies.

paite: Koipeuh ah hoh mah le uh TOUPA khut atung uah aselam in ake zel a, TOUPA'N akiang ua kichiam a agensa bang in. Huchi in buai namai in abuaita kei uhi.
english: Wherever they went out, Yahweh’s hand was against them for evil, as Yahweh had spoken, and as Yahweh had sworn to them; and they were very distressed.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak a, huaite'n amau dou mite khut a pan ahunkheta hi.
english: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.

paite: Huchipi in leng avaihawmte uh thu angaikhe kei ua, pathian dangte kiang a angkawm in amaute abe zawta ua, apipute un TOUPA thupiakte pom a azuih uh lampi pen apialsan pah maimah uhi.
english: Yet they didn’t listen to their judges; for they prostituted themselves to other gods, and bowed themselves down to them. They quickly turned away from the way in which their fathers walked, obeying Yahweh’s commandments. They didn’t do so.

paite: TOUPA'N vaihawmte abawlsak chiang in, vaihawmmi kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, vaihawmte damsung in amelmate uh khut a pan ahunkhe zel hi. Amau nuaisiah mite leh hihlungkham mite ziak a amauna un, TOUPA akisiksak hi.
english: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it grieved Yahweh because of their groaning by reason of those who oppressed them and troubled them.

paite: Himahleh hichi ahong hi a, vaihawmmi asih khit chiang in, anungtolh ua, pathian dangte zui a, a-nna uh asep uah apipute uh sang mah in agamta sezaw sem ua; athilhihte uh leh apaupenna uh leng atawpsan tuan kei uhi.
english: But when the judge was dead, they turned back, and dealt more corruptly than their fathers in following other gods to serve them and to bow down to them. They didn’t cease what they were doing, or give up their stubborn ways.

paite: Israelte tung ah TOUPA ahehta a, "Hiai namte'n apipute uh thu ka piak, ka thukhun abohsia ua, ka thu lah angaikhe kei ua;
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel; and he said, “Because this nation transgressed my covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not listened to my voice,

paite: huaiziak in tuban Joshua sih ma a delhkhiak louh namte ka delhkhiaksak nawn kei ding.
english: I also will no longer drive out any of the nations that Joshua left when he died from before them;

paite: Apipute uh zuih bang a TOUPA dan zuih ding leh ding louh uh Israelte ze-etna ding in amau ka zang ding," achi hi.
english: that by them I may test Israel, to see if they will keep Yahweh’s way to walk therein, as their fathers kept it, or not.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N huai namte delhkhe pah lou in a-omsakta a; Joshua khut ah leng apekhe kei hi.
english: So Yahweh left those nations, without driving them out hastily. He didn’t deliver them into Joshua’s hand.
